S. 1A.
No. A 797

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. D. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2899
18.11.31.

Shanghai Municipal Council.

November 13, 1931.

POLICE FORCE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE
P. O. BOX NO. 156

Deputy Commissioner (Divisions).
Deputy Commissioner (Armed & Training Reserve).
Deputy Commissioner (Time). ✓

The ruling contained in Police Order C.4386 of
November 9 does not apply to police officers who were
engaged as temporary constables and subsequently con-
firmed in their appointments.

In their case the full time served, temporary and
otherwise, counts towards full service benefits.

Commissioner of Police.

Rec
10/11

1931年11月13日。

警务处
总监办公室
邮政信箱第156号

副总监（各分区）。
副总监（武装及训练后备队）。
副总监（时限）。✓

11月9日发布的警务命令 C.4386 号中所载之规定，不适用于那些先以临时巡捕身份受聘、随后其任命得到确认的警务人员。

在此类情况下，其全部服役时间，包括临时服役期及其他时期，均计入全额服务福利的计算年限。

警务总监。

收件
11/10

pages.en:
Police Order No. C. 4306 dated 9.11.31.

The Council has ruled that temporary service shall not
be admitted in assessing the period of service required prior
to the granting of long leave.
(General Board Order No. 12025 of November 6, 1931).
pages.zh:
1931年11月9日发布的警务命令第 C. 4306 号。

工部局已裁定，在核定授予长假所需的服役年限时，临时服役期不得计入在内。
（依据1931年11月6日总董事会命令第12025号）。
